items.title: datasette 1.0a43
items.summary: Release: datasette 1.0a43 I've been leaning hard into Claude Fable 5.2 to help knock things off the 1.0 milestone , which is now 53% complete. The biggest 1.0 item in this release is streaming support for output renderers - the built-in TSV and CSV export mechanisms now use this as well, and plugins can register themselves as capable of streaming every row in a table in one go via the new Response.stream() method. There are a couple of security fixes, one of which I deemed deserving of a GitHub advisory : private stored queries could be exposed, granting access to the title and SQL of the quer...

items.summary: Release: datasette-apps 0.4a0 Datasette Apps are sandboxed HTML and JavaScript applications that live inside Datasette - think Claude Artifacts, but these ones can run SQL queries against your data. 0.4a0 adds support for linking: you can link to an app with #fragments in the URL and the app can see and use those, plus supported URL schemes are reported back to Datasette Agent so it can help write apps that link to each other. This means you can have e.g. an app that shows details about a specific record, and a completely separate app that searches those records and links to their representati...

items.title: datasette-llm 0.1a11
items.summary: Release: datasette-llm 0.1a11 datasette-llm is the intermediate plugin for Datasette that supports configuring LLMs for use with other Datasette plugins. This release adds support for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, so you can configure Datasette to use an LLM hosted anywhere that talks the OpenAI pseudo-standard web protocol. This means that if you're running local models with LM Studio or Ollama or llama.cpp (which just hit v1.0.0 ) you can run Datasette via uvx like this: wget https://datasette.io/content.db uvx --with datasette-agent datasette \ --root --secret 1 \ -s plugins.datasette-llm.de...

items.title: datasette-vega 0.7
items.summary: Release: datasette-vega 0.7 A new release of Datasette's longest untouched plugin, for rendering charts (using Vega-Lite ) against data in a table or custom query. The last release was in July 2018! I finally bumped it for compatibility with the latest Datasette alphas, plus some cosmetic tweaks to make it work better with Datasette Lite . (Datasette Lite just gained the ability to run JavaScript plugins like this! I'll write more about that soon.) Since it works with Datasette Lite, the live demo in the README now links to this demo on Datasette Lite . Tags: datasette , datasette-lite

items.title: datasette-cluster-map 0.19
items.summary: Release: datasette-cluster-map 0.19 One of the oldest Datasette plugins, and still one of my favorites. It now works with Datasette 1.0a42, and depends on the new datasette-leaflet to ensure OpenStreetMap tiles are requested with a referrer header. Here's a map of power plants owned by California's PG&E , also demonstrating Datasette's recently redesigned facets : Tags: datasette , geospatial , openstreetmap

items.title: datasette-leaflet 0.3
items.summary: Release: datasette-leaflet 0.3 OpenStreetMap have a very reasonable policy that hits to their hosted tile server should send a referrer header . Datasette table pages used the Referrer-Policy: no-referrer HTTP header, causing plugins that loaded tiles from OpenStreetMap to violate that policy. datasette-leaflet is the plugin that loads a bundled Leaflet so other Datasette plugins can depend on it. It now sets the referrer policy on the tile requests themselves to strict-origin-when-cross-origin , passing the host but not the full path to the page. Tags: leaflet , datasette , openstreetmap

items.title: Nên chọn Cloud AI hay Edge AI?
items.summary: [English below] Trong giai đoạn đầu của làn sóng AI, điện toán đám mây được xem như giải pháp cho mọi bài toán. Tuy nhiên, tương tự như quá trình chuyển dịch lịch sử từ hệ thống máy tính lớn (mainframe) sang mô hình máy khách - máy chủ (client - server), AI đang bước vào giai đoạn tái phân bổ hạ tầng. Những tác vụ mang tính đặc thù ngành như ngân hàng hay y tế đòi hỏi các mô hình chuyên biệt, chạy cục bộ để tối ưu về độ trễ, chi phí và tính kiểm soát. Xem phiên bản đầy đủ tập 416 Vietnam Innovators (Tiếng Anh) trên các kênh Youtube, Spotify & Apple Podcasts của Vietnam Innovators Digest để lắng nghe trọn vẹn chia sẻ từ ông David McQuarrie - Chủ tịch Điều hành Thương mại HP toàn cầu. - Early on, everyone assumed the cloud was the answer to every AI challenge. But just like mainframes gave way to client-servers, AI is moving to the edge. For banking and healthcare, running models locally delivers the speed, privacy, and cost savings the cloud simply cannot match.
